title: API Type LootMethod
wikitext: These are the loot methods used by GetLootMethod() == Values == ; "freeforall" Free-for-all, everyone can loot corpses. ; "roundrobin" Round-robin, looting cycles evenly through group members. ; "group" Group loot, round-robin for normal items, rolling for special ones. ; "needbeforegreed" Need before greed, round-robin for normal items, selective rolling for special ones. ; "master" Master looter, designated player distributes loot. [[Category:API Types]]
